# onboard

First-run setup for the Content Repurpose System. Walks a creator through connecting their YouTube channel, writing their Voice DNA into the content prompts, and (optionally) wiring up Apify, Supabase, and Twitter keys — then prints the end-to-end workflow they can run next. Trigger on 'onboard', 'set up the content system', 'set up content repurpose', 'get started with content repurpose', 'configure my channel', or the first time someone tries to use ideation / hooks / outlines / content-cascade / short-form / yt-titles without having configured a channel yet.

## Use

Ask your agent to use `$onboard`, or have it read [SKILL.md](./SKILL.md) before starting the task.
